industries.subtitle: Real macroeconomic data — GST collections, CPI inflation, trade balance, PMI, repo rate, and currency

summaryGrowthMetrics.title: GST Collections
summaryGrowthMetrics.description: Shows total indirect tax collected from goods and services; indicates business activity and consumption strength.

summaryGrowthMetrics.title: Retail Inflation (CPI)
summaryGrowthMetrics.description: Measures price rise for household goods and services; shows cost-of-living pressure.

summaryGrowthMetrics.title: India Trade Balance
summaryGrowthMetrics.description: Difference between India’s exports and imports; negative means imports are higher than exports.

summaryGrowthMetrics.title: Composite PMI
summaryGrowthMetrics.description: Tracks combined activity in manufacturing and services; above 50 means economic expansion.

summaryGrowthMetrics.title: India VIX
summaryGrowthMetrics.description: Measures expected stock market volatility; higher VIX means higher market fear or uncertainty.

summaryGrowthMetrics.title: India Interest Rate
summaryGrowthMetrics.description: RBI policy rate; impacts loan costs, borrowing demand, and liquidity.

summaryGrowthMetrics.title: Dollar Rupee Exchange Rate
summaryGrowthMetrics.description: Shows INR value against USD; higher number means rupee depreciation.

summaryGrowthMetrics.title: DXY Index
summaryGrowthMetrics.description: Measures US dollar strength against major global currencies; higher DXY means stronger dollar globally.

summaryGrowthMetrics.title: India Deposit Growth Rate
summaryGrowthMetrics.description: Growth in bank deposits; indicates savings flow into the banking system.

summaryGrowthMetrics.title: India Credit growth rate
summaryGrowthMetrics.description: Growth in bank loans; indicates borrowing demand from businesses and consumers.

summaryGrowthMetrics.title: India Gold Reserve
summaryGrowthMetrics.description: Value of gold held by RBI; part of India’s foreign reserve buffer.

summaryGrowthMetrics.title: India FX Reserves (USD)
summaryGrowthMetrics.description: Total foreign currency reserves held by RBI; supports currency stability and import cover.
